text: The evening metformin went down with her soup.
Put down that Aylin gave the metformin at six forty.
Is there a second metformin logged for this morning?
Sam forgot to log the metformin, I gave it at nine.
Her amlodipine is the little round one, I gave it.
Did the amlodipine get logged before Sam left?
Amlodipine done, she had it with toast.
Write that the amlodipine was given late today.
Levothyroxine first thing, before her tea.
Has Priya seen that the levothyroxine is logged?
I think the levothyroxine was missed yesterday.
She swallowed the levothyroxine with a full glass of water.
